label: Incense
_comment: Incense pricing is best compared per stick, not per pack — the builder computes that from size (stick count).

products.name: Incense Sticks (Grand Chalet / Delhi / Tokyo)
products.notes: Made in Japan, sold as a French design object. The reference for craft-premium incense.

products.name: Ceramic Incense Holder
products.notes: Accessory attach is a large share of basket in this category.

products.name: Incense Sticks
products.notes: Very high per-stick. Scarcity distribution — verify current pack count before quoting.

products.name: Horin Series Incense
products.notes: Home price in JPY. Kyoto master-blender credibility; the quality benchmark.

products.name: Daily Incense (bulk)
products.notes: Home price in JPY. Shows how wide the per-stick spread is inside one brand.

products.name: Mainichi-Koh Sandalwood
products.notes: Home price in JPY. Scale Japanese incense at mid price.

products.name: Hexa Incense Sticks
products.notes: Home price in INR. Absolute price floor — per-stick multiple vs Astier is the headline stat.

products.name: Scented Incense (Baies / Figuier)
products.notes: Diptyque is in incense too — often missed when brands scope this category.

products.name: Bakhoor (assorted)
products.notes: Home currency IS AED. Bakhoor/oud is the incumbent home-scent behaviour in the UAE — any incense entry has to be positioned against this, not against Astier.

products.name: Frankincense Home Collection
products.notes: Regional luxury provenance — frankincense from Oman. Strong story to benchmark against.
